title: TRSCORE: A NOVEL GPT-BASED READABILITY SCORER FOR ASR SEGMENTATION AND PUNCTUATION MODEL EVALUATION AND SELECTION
reasoning: The paper introduces a novel readability scoring metric for ASR outputs. It focuses on technical aspects like segmentation, punctuation, capitalization, and disfluency, and evaluates various systems. There is no component evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as a core part of its research.
